# KINGAI Office

## English
KINGAI Office is a KING AI ecosystem productivity product for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF workflows and intelligent assistance. Public information repository only; proprietary production source and private implementation are not published here.

Official ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work
Business & partnership: vip@kingai.work
Public facts: README.md
Business direction: BUSINESS.md
Roadmap: ROADMAP.md

## 中文
KINGAI Office 是 KING AI 主生态的办公生产力产品，覆盖文档、表格、演示、PDF 与智能办公辅助。本仓库仅发布公开产品资料，不公开生产源码、私有实现和敏感基础设施。

官网：https://www.kingai.work
商务与合作：vip@kingai.work
公开事实：README.md
